summary: North kerb with homes 1-8 m from the road along its whole length.
reasons: Few parked cars on this side

best_section.where: Marston Avenue north kerb between the houses at about 53 m and 90 m

drivers.seclusion: Every stretch has a house within 10 m: 1 m at 16 m, 7 m at 53 m, 7 m at 90 m, 6 m at 114 m and 8 m at 134 m. The gap between 62 and 80 m is only a screened front garden.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge; a van can stop at the kerb.
drivers.convention: A car or two parked on the street; no camping convention.

flags: Homes directly beside the kerb all along this side
Max grade 7% near the west end; flat at the best section
sun_shade: Trees and hedges on the north side shade the kerb from the north; open to the south.
